name: Dark and Light: Thread of the Worlds
source:
After Rin's actions, the thread of worlds was broken, and the universe was engulfed in chaos. The hero, who has mastered the power of darkness and light, has the most difficult task - to restore balance and save the destroyed worlds. His sisters are an unexpected and valuable addition, their appearance was a surprise for him. Enemies such as Lucifer and the Inquisition intend not to give up. The fate of all worlds depends on his choice. He must find the strength to mend the broken thread and bring hope back to the abyss of chaos.

[From [url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/dark-and-light-thread-of-the-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凛的行动之后，世界之线被打破，宇宙陷入混乱。掌握了黑暗与光明力量的英雄面临着最艰巨的任务——恢复平衡并拯救被摧毁的世界。他的姐妹们是一个意想不到的、有价值的补充，她们的出现对他来说是一个惊喜。路西法和宗教裁判所等敌人并不打算放弃。所有世界的命运都取决于他的选择。他必须找到力量来修补断线，将希望带回混乱的深渊。

[来自[url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/dark-and-light-thread-of-the-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
